name: Frosviernr Joraelnaero
desc:
Frosviernr is a Kyrsan NPC found in [second floor](location:new_kyrsa) of the [Second Layer](location:second_layer), in an alleyway behind a building following the right side of the city during the escape sequence. He made and wields the Kyrswynter.

He is the brother of fellow Kyrsan [Naerotiv](entity:naerotiv).
